title: The Punch That Boils Water
description:
The peacock mantis shrimp throws the fastest punch in the animal kingdom — fast enough to superheat the water around it. Here's how it works, and why its eyes are just as wild as its claw.

#shorts #sciencefacts #oceananimals

scenes.text: This shrimp can boil water with a single punch.
The peacock mantis shrimp swings its claw with the acceleration of a bullet leaving a gun barrel.
It's so fast the water flashes into light and boils for a fraction of a second.
Scientists call that cavitation, and the shockwave can kill prey even if the claw misses.
Its eyes are just as wild. It has sixteen types of color receptors.
You have three. It might be seeing colors that don't even have a name.
Follow for more ocean facts that sound fake but are completely real.
